thread:
alex: quick follow-up on the pinning metadata RFC — major tenants hit header bloat. need a compact hint we can send on each request.

sam: +1. attaching full rollout manifests to every placement call is the root cause.

jordan: thought: send a digest prefix plus a tiny affinity score. keep the full rollout in control-plane sync/cache.

lee: good, but collision rules must be explicit so client and resolver pick the same variant.

maria: minimal wire hint I sketched: `pin_prefix:sha256:abcd12`, `affinity:0.78`, `pin_version:v3`. tiny and sufficient.

alex: tradeoffs: smaller requests, more resolver complexity, need telemetry for ambiguous resolutions.

sam: enforce min_prefix_len=6 hex chars (48 bits) to make random collisions practically impossible.

jordan: resolver precedence: 1) exact id, 2) longest prefix match, 3) highest affinity, 4) lexicographic. document & test.

lee: storage model: keep canonical full_id in DB, precompute/index supported prefixes for fast lookup. don't store ephemeral prefix-only records.

maria: include `pin_digest_version` or `pin_epoch` on hints so resolver can reject stale pins after rotations.

alex: wire format: compact TLV binary encoded in header (base64). gateway decodes for logging/telemetry so operators see readable manifests.

sam: metrics: `prefix_resolve_rate`, `ambiguous_resolve_count`, `fallback_reason`. alert if prefix_resolve_rate > 0.5% per tenant.

jordan: migration: accept both `full_pin_id` and `pin_prefix`; prefer `full_pin_id` when present. start in advisory mode behind a feature flag, canary top tenants first.

lee: action items: lee -> TLV prototype + client shim; maria -> DB + manifest linter (enforce min_prefix_len); jordan -> RFC tie-break rules + telemetry; alex -> feature-flag + canaries; sam -> gateway header cap & alerts.

deploy-bot: @alex kicked off canary for prefix-hints feature on dev at 2024-11-12T15:02Z :rocket:

alex: also add gateway hard header-size cap to avoid regressions.

sam: sounds good. closing — will track PRs in RFC thread. :thumbsup:
